summary: The Ansible plug-ins can be delivered as OCI artifacts pulled from registry.redhat.io at startup (recommended, no manual downloads) or from a self-hosted HTTP plug-in registry, used when OCI pulls from registry.redhat.io are not possible.
questions: OCI vs HTTP plug-in registry for Ansible RHDH plug-ins
Which plug-in delivery method is recommended?
My cluster can't pull from registry.redhat.io, how do I install the plug-ins?
